text:
A Lake Wind Advisory is in effect, so if you're heading to the waterfront, expect a brisk south wind tonight, 15 to 25 knots, with waves building to 1 to 3 feet. Sunset comes at 6:33 under a cloudy sky, and the evening stays mild near 65, though gusts could reach 26 mph. Showers become more likely after midnight, with a 50 percent chance overall.

Friday is the wet turn. Rain showers are likely much of the day, with a high near 67 early, then temperatures sliding toward 61 through the afternoon. Winds shift from south to west and ease some, but the lake remains choppy with 1 to 2-foot waves. Plan on rain gear for Friday, and keep waterfront plans short tonight, especially after dark.
